scripts.build:baseline: npm run typecheck:baseline && vite build --config variants/baseline/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:design-rules: npm run typecheck:design-rules && vite build --config variants/design-rules/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:design-workflow: npm run typecheck:design-workflow && vite build --config variants/design-workflow/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:variants: npm run build:baseline && npm run build:design-rules && npm run build:design-workflow
scripts.test:blind: vitest run evaluation/blind-map.test.ts && EXPERIMENT_SERVER_MODE=blind playwright test -c evaluation/playwright.config.ts evaluation/blind-launcher.spec.ts
